# WBS Epic: Pillar Evolution

This epic tracks the evolution of each of the five pillars from the 2025 framing into the 2026 four-layer stack. Each pillar becomes one or more layers; this epic owns the cross-pillar reconciliation.

## Pillar mapping (2025 → 2026)

- Pillar 1 (Data Provenance) → Layer 1 + Layer 4
- Pillar 2 (Contextual Signature) → Layer 2
- Pillar 3 (Chain of Evidence) → Layers 1, 3, 4
- Pillar 4 (Explainability Anchoring) → Layers 2, 4
- Pillar 5 (Human Validation) → Layers 3, 4

## Acceptance

- Each pillar doc in `docs/pillars/01..05.md` reads as an evolution narrative, not a restated 2025 claim
- Cross-references between pillar docs and `docs/architecture/four-layer-stack.md` are bidirectional
- One open question per pillar, surfaced in `ROADMAP.md`
